ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the lead status. When it matches a stored lead status, that lead status is updated. Otherwise a new lead status is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the lead status.

Description.description: Administrative description of the lead status.

Order.description: Position of the status in lists, lowest first.

IsDefault.description: Whether a new lead starts in this status.

IsClosed.description: Whether a lead in this status is closed.

IsConverted.description: Whether this is the status a lead takes when it is converted.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the lead status, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

LeadStatuses.description: The lead statuses to create or update.
